config.title: The 7am round
config.content: Margaret in Room 4 has a prescribed barrier cream for her heels, applied twice a day. It is 7am and you are doing the round. Set up, go in, apply it properly, and then tell her daughter what you did when she visits.

config.title: Set up the trolley
config.question: Put each item where it belongs before you go in. Anything that should not be on the round at all, leave where it is.

dragItems.label: Margaret's prescribed barrier cream (pharmacy label in her name)
Yesterday's used gloves, left on the trolley

config.title: Apply Margaret's barrier cream
config.question: Perform the steps in the order you would on the floor. A step taken out of turn has its consequence straight away.

procedureSteps.text: Check the care plan and MAR chart for what is prescribed, where, and when it was last applied

procedureSteps.ifEarly: You have touched the door, the trolley and the chart since you last washed. Hands first, every time.

procedureSteps.text: Explain what you are going to do and gain Margaret's consent
procedureSteps.ifEarly: Margaret has not agreed to anything yet. Touching her without consent is the one thing that ends this round.
Gloves go on after hand hygiene and after consent, not before either.

procedureSteps.text: Apply a thin layer to both heels, in the direction of hair growth
procedureSteps.ifEarly: Cream on before clean hands and consent is exactly what this round is testing for.

procedureSteps.text: Remove gloves and wash your hands
procedureSteps.ifEarly: There is nothing to take off yet. Gloves come off after the cream is on.

procedureSteps.text: Record on the MAR chart with the time and your initials
procedureSteps.ifEarly: You cannot record what you have not yet done.

config.title: Stop there
config.content:
The round stopped the moment a critical step was taken out of turn. In a real home that is a safeguarding conversation, not a score. You made {missteps} misstep(s) before it stopped.

Go back to the start and run the round again.

nodes.title: Tell Margaret's daughter what you did

config.title: Tell Margaret's daughter what you did
config.persona: You are Claire, Margaret's daughter, visiting after work. You are polite but watchful: you have read about skin damage in care homes and you want to know, in plain words, what was put on your mum, why, and whether she agreed to it. You are not medical. You notice when someone hides behind jargon.
config.firstMessage: Hi, I'm Claire, Margaret's daughter. Did you do her cream this morning? What is it actually for?
config.objective: The learner should explain what the barrier cream is for and where it was applied, say that they gained Margaret's consent before touching her, and be honest about any misstep in the round rather than minimising it. Grade each rubric criterion on the transcript alone.

rubric.label: Explained what the cream is for, in plain words
Said that Margaret's consent was gained before anything was applied
Was honest about any misstep without minimising it

config.title: Round complete
config.content: Round complete with {missteps} misstep(s). Claire's conversation is scored out of 100; a pass is 60 or more.

variables.name: missteps
variables.description: Steps taken out of turn during the round

variables.name: critical_failure
variables.description: Set the moment consent or hand hygiene is breached

variables.name: explain_score
variables.description: How well the round was explained to Margaret's daughter (0 to 100)
